summary: New guide /blog/how-to-find-your-travel-history (title 'I-94 Travel History: How to Find All Your Past Trips'): step-by-step CBP I-94 'View Travel History' lookup, its 10-year limit and gaps (not an official record; US citizens and green-card holders excluded; land and cruise gaps; one search per passport), corrections, CBP FOIA via SecureRelease, why there is no passport travel log, EU EES replacing stamps, Canada/Australia/UK record requests, Gmail search and Google Maps Timeline (now device-only), what UK, Schengen, DS-160, N-400 and Canadian citizenship forms ask for, and TripCache's free Travel History and Visa / Immigration Summary export (stored trips only; not a government record). 8-question FAQ with FAQPage JSON-LD.
why: Semrush wave 2: 'i-94 travel history' 4,400/mo US (KD 34), 'the us document that shows your travel history' 320 (KD 35), 'how to check my passport travel history' 210 (KD 29), 'us travel history i94' 170, '1 94 travel history' 110, 'travel history google maps' 110. The free Visa / Immigration Summary export answers the follow-up need. Expect first impressions within 28 days.
